## Project

```bash
cp -r starter my-game && cd my-game
npm install          # once
npm run dev          # localhost:5173
npm run build        # → dist/
npm run preview      # check the build
```

Add `?debug` to the address to see physics bodies (if the config reads it).

## Game config

```js
new Phaser.Game({
  type: Phaser.AUTO,
  parent: 'game',
  width: 960, height: 540,
  pixelArt: true,
  scale: { mode: Phaser.Scale.FIT,
           autoCenter: Phaser.Scale.CENTER_BOTH },
  physics: { default: 'arcade' },
  input: { activePointers: 2 },
  scene: [Boot, Title, Play, Hud],
});
```

## A scene

```js
export class Play extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor() { super('Play'); }
  init(data) {}    // data from start(); reset here
  preload() {}     // queue files
  create() {}      // build, once files have loaded
  update(time, delta) {} // every frame, delta in ms
}
```

## Load (in `preload`)

```js
this.load.setPath('assets');
this.load.image('tube', 'sprites/tube.png');
this.load.spritesheet('hero', 'sprites/hero.png',
  { frameWidth: 32, frameHeight: 32 });
this.load.atlas('ui', 'ui.png', 'ui.json');
this.load.audio('ding', ['ding.ogg', 'ding.mp3']);
this.load.tilemapTiledJSON('map', 'maps/floor.tmj');
this.load.on('progress', (v) => {});  // 0 to 1
```

## Add things

```js
this.add.image(x, y, 'tube');
this.add.sprite(x, y, 'hero', 1);   // can animate
this.add.tileSprite(0, 0, w, h, 'lab', 0)
  .setOrigin(0);
this.add.text(x, y, 'Hi', { fontSize: '24px' });
this.add.rectangle(x, y, w, h, 0xff0000);
this.add.zone(x, y, w, h);          // invisible
```

| Setter | Does |
|---|---|
| `setOrigin(0.5)` | which point sits at `x, y` (images: middle; text: top-left) |
| `setScale(2)` `setFlipX(true)` | size, mirror |
| `setAlpha(0.5)` `setVisible(false)` | transparency, hide |
| `setDepth(10)` | draw order (higher on top) |
| `setTint(0xff8888)` | tint (and `clearTint()`) |
| `setScrollFactor(0)` | stay on screen as the camera moves |

## Keyboard and pointer

```js
const kb = this.input.keyboard;
this.cursors = kb.createCursorKeys();
this.keys = kb.addKeys('W,A,S,D');
this.cursors.left.isDown;   // held down
// pressed this frame only:
Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown(this.cursors.space);
kb.once('keydown-SPACE', fn);
this.input.on('pointerdown', (p) => { p.x; p.y; });
sprite.setInteractive().on('pointerdown', fn);
this.sys.game.device.input.touch;   // touch screen?
```

## Arcade physics

```js
const p = this.physics.add.sprite(x, y, 'hero');
this.physics.add.existing(rect);        // dynamic
this.physics.add.existing(zone, true);  // static
p.setVelocity(vx, vy);
p.setAcceleration(ax, ay);
p.setMaxVelocity(220);
p.setDrag(1800);   // only acts with no acceleration
p.setBounce(1);
p.setCollideWorldBounds(true);
p.setPushable(false);   // others can't shove it
p.body.setSize(18, 14).setOffset(7, 17);
p.body.reset(x, y);     // teleport, zero velocity
p.disableBody(true, true);
p.enableBody(true, x, y, true, true);
this.physics.world.setBounds(0, 0, w, h);
```

```js
const phys = this.physics;
phys.add.collider(a, b, onHit, null, this);   // solid
phys.add.overlap(a, b, onTouch, null, this);  // report
phys.overlap(a, b);   // true or false, right now
```

## Groups

```js
const walls = this.physics.add.staticGroup();
walls.create(x, y, 'lab', 2);
const carts = this.physics.add.group();
carts.create(x, y, 'cart');
carts.getChildren().forEach((c) => {});
carts.countActive();
```

## Tilemaps (Tiled JSON, tileset embedded)

```js
const map = this.make.tilemap({ key: 'map' });
// tileset name in Tiled, then the image's key:
const tiles = map.addTilesetImage('lab', 'lab-tiles');
const walls = map.createLayer('walls', tiles);
walls.setCollisionByProperty({ collides: true });
// each has x, y, type, properties:
const objs = map.getObjectLayer('objects').objects;
const w = map.widthInPixels, h = map.heightInPixels;
```

## Camera

```js
const cam = this.cameras.main;
cam.setBounds(0, 0, w, h);
cam.startFollow(player, true, 0.12, 0.12); // lerp
cam.setZoom(2);
cam.setDeadzone(200, 120);
cam.shake(140, 0.006);
cam.flash(150, 255, 80, 80);
cam.fadeOut(500);
cam.once('camerafadeoutcomplete', fn);
this.cameras.add(x, y, w, h);   // a second camera
```

## Animation

```js
// once, for the whole game
this.anims.create({
  key: 'walk',
  frames: this.anims.generateFrameNumbers('hero',
    { start: 0, end: 3 }),
  frameRate: 10,
  repeat: -1,   // forever
});
sprite.anims.play('walk', true); // true: don't restart
sprite.anims.stop();
sprite.setFrame(1);
```

## Tweens, timers, particles

```js
this.tweens.add({
  targets: obj,
  scale: { from: 1.8, to: 1 },
  duration: 250,
  ease: 'Back.Out',   // also: yoyo, repeat, delay
  onComplete: () => {},
});
this.time.delayedCall(450, () => {});
this.time.addEvent({ delay: 1000, loop: true,
  callback: fn });

const fx = this.add.particles(0, 0, 'frost', {
  speed: { min: 60, max: 200 },
  lifespan: 800,
  scale: { start: 1.4, end: 0 },
  emitting: false,
});
fx.explode(24, x, y);     // a burst
fx.startFollow(player);   // a trail...
fx.start();  fx.stop();   // ...on and off
```

## Sound

```js
this.sound.play('ding', { volume: 0.5, rate: 1.2 });
const music = this.sound.add('theme', { loop: true });
music.play();
this.sound.mute = true;
// no sound until the first click or key press
```

## Scenes and shared state

| Call | Does |
|---|---|
| `this.scene.start('Play', data)` | stop this scene, start `Play` |
| `this.scene.launch('Hud')` | run `Hud` alongside |
| `this.scene.restart(data)` | run `init` and `create` again |
| `this.scene.pause()` / `resume('Play')` | freeze, carry on |
| `this.scene.stop('Hud')` | stop another scene |

```js
this.registry.set('thaw', 40);  // every scene sees it
this.registry.events.on('changedata', fn, this);
// clean up what you attached to longer-lived things:
this.events.once('shutdown', () => {});
```

## Save

```js
const KEY = 'my-game:best';   // namespaced
try {
  localStorage.setItem(KEY, String(ms));
} catch {}
const best = Number(localStorage.getItem(KEY)) || null;
// objects: JSON.stringify in, JSON.parse out
```

## Deploy

`vite.config.js`: `base: './'`. GitHub: Settings → Pages → GitHub Actions, then a workflow that runs `npm ci`, `npm run build` and uploads `dist/` ([lesson 10](lessons/10-ship.qmd#put-it-online)).

## Phaser 3 habits that break in 4

- `group.children.each(fn)` is gone. Use `group.getChildren().forEach(fn)`.
- `setTintFill(c)` does nothing. Use `setTint(c)`, then `setTintMode(Phaser.TintModes.FILL)`.
- `map.createStaticLayer` and `createDynamicLayer` are gone. Use `map.createLayer`.

:::
